literal_owner_handoff.reason: Isolate the CLI test's handoff directory before owner handoff audit; it can replace pending.json in the documented default owner folder.

live_monitoring_now.reason: No owner workspace/watchlist, real permitted/current bar source, private DB/handoff paths or optional schedule supplied.

product_behavior: Personal workspace starts empty; owner creates/imports records and authors a versioned recipe/Eye locally.
Worker CLI runs while UI closed, reads SYMBOL.csv OHLCV files and writes SQLite job/evaluation history.
Worker publishes bounded content-addressed pending.json to the selected local folder; full app export is produced only when --output FILE is explicitly supplied.
Later secure browser open validates pending evidence, applies only to the existing workspace after owner identity checks, commits by compare-and-set, then writes ack.json.
Today/Alerts show captured context; Journal decisions and outcomes are deliberate. Settings exposes permission, partial, missed, stale, conflict, retry and recovery states.
StockLedger installs no scheduler, keeps no machine awake, acquires no feed, sends no required email and cannot prove human review.

owner_supplied_setup.action: Supply permitted completed daily OHLCV files, explicit adjustment and truthful source.
Verify chosen source rights, availability, freshness and update cadence; no provider contacted.
Choose private SQLite/handoff paths and grant the same folder to the secure browser.
Install/monitor launchd/cron or equivalent; machine awake and authorized input path readable. Manual runs remain possible.
Choose private backup destination/cadence; backups are plaintext and RPO since operator backup is unknown without cadence.
In-app review is sufficient. Credentials/destination only if owner later chooses external email.

shortest_safe_path: 1. Install Node 22.23.2, npm ci, npm run web in secure desktop browser.
2. Create/import the real watchlist, author/version a recipe, bind an Eye; import completed bars with declared source/adjustment.

3. Export app JSON; initialize worker and take first SQLite snapshot: npm run worker -- --db /absolute/private/worker.sqlite --import /absolute/private/StockLedger.json --backup /absolute/private/worker-initial.sqlite.
4. In Settings → Workspace and data → Local worker review handoff, choose a private folder. Keep that same absolute path in every invocation.

5. With UI closed run: npm run worker -- --db /absolute/private/worker.sqlite --csv /absolute/path/daily-bars --adjustment adjusted --source 'Owner verified source / dataset release' --handoff-dir /absolute/private/stockledger-handoff.
6. If unattended operation is desired, owner installs launchd/cron with absolute paths/private logs and keeps machine awake/input readable; there is no installed-schedule guarantee.
7. Later open app, re-grant folder if needed, inspect Settings state and worker coverage, review Today/Alerts, then record decision/lesson in Journal.
8. Next worker invocation consumes ack.json. Replay is idempotent. Inspect stale/missing/partial/missed/conflict states; do not infer success from invocation/email intent.

9. Restore consistent SQLite backup to a new path, check integrity and validate export before switching; use prior valid app copy or validated JSON import for app recovery. Keep DB/WAL/SHM and plaintext exports private.
owner_run_guarantees: A sleeping host catches up only after wake; no hosted SLA.
Catch-up is bounded and blocked work remains visible.
Today/Alerts are sufficient; SMTP/provider acceptance/human reading are distinct.
